newsitem.title: USA: PECO Pa. nuclear power plant still off line.
newsitem.headline: PECO Pa. nuclear power plant still off line.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's Peach Bottom 2 nuclear power unit, in Delta, Pa., is still off line, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
PECO said Thursday they expected the 1,100 megawatt (MW) unit to start putting power back on the grid late Thursday.
The unit was taken off line early Wednesday due to a problem with the oil line to the generator.
Spot prices for next-day firm electricity for peak deliveries fell to as low as $21.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) on Thursday in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool.
However, market sources speculated that prices would rebound closer to the $27.00 high seen on Wednesday as a cold front pushed into the Northeast.
